items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Well I met my young lady here, Evelyn

ctx.x: What made you decide to move here?

Well I met my young lady here, Evelyn, and of course so many other different things, I like the town. See I been coming back and forth here the past 30 years with different bands, Cab, Louie, with my own group, I played here so many times in different places around here, Benny Klein's, Tommy Hendricks, the Roarin' Twenties Club around here, I've been playing in and out of Columbus for the past 30 years. So I have very nice tie-in with a lot of friends and club owners and everything around here. I wasn't new, it…
Okay, how long have you been going to Capital University?
